_comment: Sign classes (sign_id) -> Kannada display text. Fields: label = sign class ID used by the model; isl_gloss = conventional upper-case gloss of the ISL sign; kannada = Kannada display text (NFC Unicode); english = English gloss; verified = whether an ISL-proficient reviewer has confirmed the sign and its Kannada rendering; notes = source / validation notes. The recognizer only outputs labels that have been recorded AND trained. '_none' is the background / non-sign class and is never added to the transcript. How each sign is performed must come from a verified ISL reference (e.g. the ISLRTC dictionary); this file does not define the signs.

labels.label: thank_you
labels.notes: Plural/polite form; ಧನ್ಯವಾದ is accepted as an alias.

labels.label: food
labels.notes: ಊಟ = meal; ಆಹಾರ = food in general.

labels.label: i_me
labels.notes: Pointing sign; inflected forms (ನನಗೆ, ನನ್ನ) map here in Kannada-to-Sign.

labels.label: you
labels.notes: Polite form; ನೀನು maps here in Kannada-to-Sign.

labels.label: _none
labels.notes: Background class used to reject non-signs.
